description: Search our checked list of live startup, SaaS, AI tool and general directories that accept product submissions. Free, no account needed. Each result has the submit URL, domain rating, pricing (free / freemium / paid), whether it needs an account, email confirmation, a captcha or a backlink, when we last checked it, and a step-by-step guide link where we have one. Highest domain rating first.

category.description: Only directories that list this kind of product. "general" = any product.

free_only.description: Only directories with a free way to submit (pricing free or freemium).

no_account.description: Only directories that need no account.

query.description: Part of the directory name or domain.

name: search_directories
title: Search product directories
